text:
Noah Park: Heads-up on CitrineData onboarding health  p95 for /chat/generate jumped to ~520ms over last 24h (we're targeting 320ms) and token cost ~+27% vs plan. Renewal in ~4w. Looking for low-risk lever: experiment with int8 quant + model-hop for retrieval-heavy flows instead of full model swap. Thoughts?
Camila Ruiz: +1. Do we have a slice by request.kv_length or doc_count? if retrieval-heavy, routing to a compact embedding+completion combo could be safer.
Noah Park: Route breakdown shows 35% of requests include multi-doc context or prefetch embeddings. I attached a small sample to the dashboard.
Ravi Patel: int8 helps but for doc-heavy flows a hybrid route is often best: run retrieval/embeddings on compact-embed and completion on compact-gen, fallback to large model only if confidence low. Keeps output stable and cuts cost.
Maya Singh: Agree. Propose cohort-based canary (user_cohort = beta) rather than global pct to reduce blast radius. Also exclude endpoints tagged `compliance` or `billing`.
Camila Ruiz: Can we get an ops-safe rollout snippet for their SREs? and automated gates: quality delta <2.5% on our anchor prompts and p95 improvement >=15% else rollback.
Ravi Patel: Snippet below for their routing layer: ```json
{
  "cohorts": [
    {"cohort":"beta-users","match":{"meta.user_cohort":"beta"},"route":[{"step":"embed","model":"citrine-compact-embed-v1"},{"step":"generate","model":"citrine-compact-gen-v2"}],"fallback":{"model":"citrine-large-fp16"}},
    {"match":{"meta.tags":["doc_search"]},"model":"compact-embed-v1+compact-gen"}
  ],
  "exclude_tags":["compliance","billing"]
}
```
Noah Park: Nice. ops-bot can you schedule a perf-smoke with 400 anonymized traces comparing the hybrid route vs current baseline (end-to-end p50/p95/p99 + token-cost + exact-match on 12 anchors)? @ops-bot
ops-bot: Job queued: perf-smoke/citrine-hybrid-1 (samples=400). ETA ~35m. I will post results in this thread.
Maya Singh: Add gating: `eval-suite run --customer citrine --suite onboarding-anchors --max-delta 0.025` to ensure quality stays within 2.5% and track hallucination-rate.
ops-bot: perf-smoke/citrine-hybrid-1 complete \u2014 summary: hybrid route p95 -18%, p99 -9%, token cost per request -15%. Eval-suite delta = +1.8% (within gate). Full logs: https://ci.redwood/smoke/citrine-hybrid-1
Camila Ruiz: Those results look like a solid low-risk win. Proposed ramp: 48h on beta cohort -> expand to 20% of non-sla users -> 48h @50% if stable. Document rollback steps and phone tree.
Ravi Patel: I'll draft rollback playbook (CLI to flip cohort routing, revoke model aliases, and run `eval-suite` health checks). Also include metric dashboards and alert thresholds.
Noah Park: Action items: Noah -> coordinate SRE window & customer note; Camila -> update renewal slide with expected savings and before/after; Ravi -> rollback playbook + runbook; Maya -> monitor eval metrics and sign off on gates.
Camila Ruiz: Also ask for a short ops quote post-20% step for the renewal deck.
Noah Park: Thanks team. I'll post the SRE snippet link and the enablement one-pager once scheduled. :rocket:
